userConfirmed.requestedOutput: Preserve the actual hum as the lead, with music around it

diagnosis.problem: Synthetic-note preservation only copied a sparse, unreliable transcription. Much of the human melody was absent before arrangement. Piano decay could further bury reconstructed notes under backing.

repair: New recordings/imports select an explicit Original hum lead, using the actual received normalized WAV at playback rate 1 and its entire source duration.
Playback and WAV export independently verify source hash, size and clock; no synthesized melody doubles or replaces the waveform.
Only a bounded constant gain, native resampling and at most 3 ms outside-edge fades affect the original waveform.
Limited transcription disables guessed chords and bass; requested unpitched rhythm develops around the actual voice.
Persistent transcription-quality feedback survives generation and style changes.
Producer instrument suggestions preserve the original voice; the explicit lead selector or note editing can select instrumental reconstruction.
Imports are staged before committing. Invalid/overlong imports retain the previous usable take.
Silent recordings do not enable composition as a substitute for a missing melody.
Missing original WAVs fail clearly; saved project settings never silently fall back to guessed instrumental notes.

actualTakeNativeAudioVerification.sourceChannels: strongest captured channel normalized to mono
actualTakeNativeAudioVerification.sourceComparison: Independent native buffer-source resampling, zero-lag waveform comparison after fitted constant gain; exclude outer 10 ms to cover the short boundary fades

regressionVerification.productionSmoke: passed: SQLite, producer status, built assets, SPA routing, source containment, project read API

limits: This implements the user's chosen recorded-voice lead; it does not establish accurate instrumental transcription of this take.
The protected waveform is the normalized mono PCM received by Muse, not a byte-identical copy of the original stereo WebM container.
Waveform matching and clipping/foreground metrics are objective checks, not a human subjective listening verdict.
Original source audio remains session-only. Reopened projects require the original file; exported WAV contains the voice and backing.
No private audio is included in this report or committed to source, and no audio was sent to an external provider.
Real MusicGen inference and universally accurate human pitch transcription remain unverified.
